text:
elaine: Pushing a tiny docs PR that standardizes trace key naming for Console widgets and adds a short normalize helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/921
omar: Can you paste the helper and the example widget so I can sanity-check the YAML?

elaine: Helper (JS):
```js
function normalizeKey(k) {
  if (!k) return '';
  return k.replace(/[^a-z0-9_.-]/gi, '_');
}
// usage: trace.tags[normalizeKey('user:plan')] = 'pro';
```

elaine: Example widget excerpt:```yaml
widget:
  type: breakdown
  key: trace.tags.user_plan
  metric: trace.metrics.estimated_cost_cents
  aggregate: sum
```

rachel: Quick note: examples in other languages show `user-plan` vs `user_plan`. We should call out that normalizeKey maps both to `user_plan` in examples to avoid confusion. Also add a one-line migration tip for older dashboards that used dashes.
omar: docs-bot flagged an absolute link to internal-runbook.md in the PR checklist. Replace with ../runbooks/internal-runbook.md.
docs-bot: lint: please add a tiny unit test in examples/js/test_normalize.js asserting `normalizeKey('user:plan') === 'user_plan'` and `normalizeKey('user-plan') === 'user-plan' -> normalize to 'user_plan'`.

elaine: Will add the test and the migration note. No code changes to runtime; docs-only. ETA ~20m to push fixes.

ci-bot: Preview build queued when CI is green (job #10777).

rachel: After CI + preview I'll do a final pass for wording. Thanks! :sparkles:
